comparison.objective: Insert a T-nut into an extrusion slot, quarter-turn it, and slide it to a mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Narrow-slot insertion, hidden rotation under lips, and constrained sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Nut is locked under the lips at the marked position and released; detailed tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: It tests geometric interlocking and in-slot translation, not threaded stop adjustment or locknut countertorque.
